QC-ABOUT-003 — Chamber's Laws
FRONTEND — Visitor Display
User Story ID
QC-ABOUT-003 | US-001 | REF:
FR-007
Title
Chamber's Laws — Visitor Display
As a
public website visitor
I want
to access Chamber's Law information and view official legal references on the Qatar Chamber website
So that
I can review the Chamber's legal framework and access official legal texts through configured external links
Preconditions:
- The Qatar Chamber website is published and accessible.
- The Chamber's Law page content is published in the CMS.
- At least one Law Entry record is published and active.
Frontend Workflow:
- Public Visitor navigates to Main Menu → About Us → Chamber's Law.
- The page loads with the full-width Hero Banner displaying the configured background image with a red/maroon overlay, the Page Title ("Chamber's Law") overlaid in white, and breadcrumb ("Home > About Us").
- The page renders in a two-column layout:
- Left column: Displays two content sections in sequence:
- Section 1 — "Chamber Legal Framework": Section heading (red) followed by introductory body paragraphs.
- Section 2 — "Official Legal References": Section heading (red) followed by repeatable law entry cards. Each card displays: a law icon, the Law Number (e.g. "Law No. 11 of 1990"), the Law Title as a red hyperlink, a description paragraph, and a "View official legal text" CTA button linking to the configured external URL.
- Right column: Displays the configured Content Image (e.g. law book with scales of justice illustration) with alt text.
- Public Visitor scrolls through the introductory content and law entries.
- Public Visitor clicks a Law Title hyperlink or "View official legal text" button — system opens the configured external URL (same or new tab per CMS configuration).
Given the visitor opens the Chamber's Law page
When the page renders
Then:
- the system shall display the Hero Banner with background image, red/maroon overlay, Page Title, and breadcrumb.
- the page shall render in a two-column layout: content sections on the left, Content Image on the right.
- the "Chamber Legal Framework" section shall display the configured section heading and introductory body paragraphs.
- the "Official Legal References" section shall display the configured section heading and all published active law entry cards in configured display order.
- each law entry card shall display: law icon, Law Number, Law Title (as a hyperlink), description, and "View official legal text" CTA button.
- the Law Title hyperlink and "View official legal text" button shall open the configured external URL per the approved open behaviour (same or new tab).
- only published and active law entry records shall be visible to public users.
- the Content Image shall display with configured alt text for accessibility.
- the page shall support bilingual content in English and Arabic with RTL support.
- only published page content shall appear on the website.
Edge Case Scenarios:
- If no law entry records are published, the "Official Legal References" section heading displays but no cards are shown.
- If a law entry has no external URL configured, the "View official legal text" button is hidden for that entry.
- If translation is missing for the selected language, the system shall fall back to the configured default language.
Negative Scenarios:
- If the page fails to load, visitor shall see a standard error page.
- Draft content shall remain visible only in CMS and shall not appear on the website.
Post Condition:
Visitor has reviewed Chamber's Law content and may have accessed an official legal text via the configured external link.
BACKEND — Admin CMS Management
User Story ID
QC-ABOUT-003 | US-002 | REF:
FR-007
Title
Chamber's Laws — CMS Management
As a
authorized admin user (Site
Content Editor / Site Content Author)
I want
to manage the Chamber's Law page content and law entry records in the CMS
So that
visitors can access accurate and up-to-date legal framework information and official legal references
Preconditions:
- Admin has Site Content Editor or Site Content Author role in Liferay CMS.
- Chamber's Law page record is accessible in the CMS.
Administrator Workflow:
- Site Content Editor or Site Content Author logs into Liferay CMS.
- Opens the Chamber's Law page record.
- Uploads or replaces the Hero Banner background image and sets alt text (EN + AR).
- Creates or updates Page Title (EN + AR).
- Creates or updates the "Chamber Legal Framework" Section Heading (EN + AR) and Intro Content (EN + AR).
- Uploads or replaces the Content Image (EN + AR) and sets alt text.
- Manages Law Entry records under "Official Legal References":
- Creates a new law entry or opens an existing one.
- Enters Law Number (EN + AR), Law Title (EN + AR), Law Description (EN + AR), and External Link URL (EN + AR).
- Uploads the Law Entry Icon.
- Sets Display Order and Active Status.
- Saves the law entry.
- Sets the "Official Legal References" Section Heading (EN + AR).
- Saves the page as draft or previews it.
- Publishes the page.
- System displays a Liferay generic success toast message (EN + AR).
- Published content reflects on the frontend after cache refresh.
Given the admin opens the Chamber's Law page record in CMS
When the admin updates and publishes the content
Then:
- the system shall allow the admin to create, edit, preview, publish, and unpublish the page where permitted.
- the admin shall be able to create, edit, reorder, activate, and deactivate individual law entry records.
- Site Content Author shall be able to view and update assigned page content where permitted.
- the system shall validate image format (JPG, PNG, SVG), image size (max 2 MB), content length, and URL format before save or publish.
- the system shall support draft → preview → publish → unpublish lifecycle.
- the system shall display a Liferay generic success toast message after each successful action (EN + AR).
- only published content shall appear on the website; draft content remains visible only in CMS.
- CMS stores updated content, updates page cache, and records the change in the audit log.
Edge Case Scenarios:
- If Arabic title is missing and Arabic is enabled: "Arabic title is required." | العنوان العربي مطلوب.
- If image size exceeds 2 MB: "Image size must not exceed 2 MB." | يجب ألا يتجاوز حجم الصورة 2 ميغابايت.
- If Hero Banner format is invalid: "Hero Banner must be JPG, PNG, or SVG." | يجب أن يكون البانر بتنسيق JPG أو PNG أو SVG.
Negative Scenarios:
- If page title is empty: "Page title is required." | عنوان الصفحة مطلوب.
- If External Link URL is invalid: "Please enter a valid URL." | يرجى إدخال رابط صالح.
- If the admin lacks permission: "Access Denied. You do not have permission to perform this action." | تم رفض الوصول. ليس لديك صلاحية لتنفيذ هذا الإجراء.
Post Condition:
Chamber's Law page and law entry records are published and visible on the website. Audit log records the change.

Permissions:
- Site Content Editor (Site Role): Create, Edit, View, Preview, Publish, Unpublish page content and law entry records where permitted.
- Site Content Author (Site Role): View and update assigned page content and law entry records where permitted.
- Public Visitor: View published page content and published active law entry cards; access external legal text links.
Business Rules:
- Only Published page content appears on the website.
- Only law entry records with Active Status = True and published status are visible on the frontend.
- Display Order controls the sequence of law entry cards.
- All images must include alt text for accessibility.
Admin Toast Messages: Use Liferay Generic Messages
(EN + AR).
